test_title: PYST 52: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 8th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A sum of Rs. 8,400 amounts to Rs. 10,899 in 3(1)/(2) years at a certain rate per cent per annum, at simple interest. What will be the amount of the same sum at simple interest for 4(2)/(3) years at double the rate of interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 8,400

Amount = Rs. 10,899

Time = 3(1/2) = (7/2) years

**Formula Used:**

**1.** SI = Amount - Principal

**2.** SI = PRT/100

Where P = Principal, R = Rate, T = Time(in years)

**Calculations:**

SI = 10,899 - 8,400 = 2,499

⇒ 2499 = [8400 × R × (7/2)] / 100

⇒ 2499 = [8400 × R × 7] / (100 × 2)

⇒ R = (2499 × 200)/(8400 × 7)

⇒ R = 8.5%

Now, we have to find the amount after 4(2/3) years at double the initial rate of interest

⇒ R = 8.5 × 2 = 17, T = 4(2/3) = (14/3) years

SI = [8400 × 17 × (14/3)] / 100

⇒ SI = (8400 × 17 × 14) / (100 × 3)

⇒ SI = 6,664

Amount = 8400 + 6664 = 15,064

**∴ The amount after 4(2/3) years at the rate of 17% will be 15,064 rupees.**
